plan.title: bug(init,security): the consumer .gitignore baseline misses the private pre-PR store and the plan-sequence lock files

narratives.Description: The consumer .gitignore baseline written by install and refresh does not cover the private pre-PR store (.deft/pre-pr-execution-private/, which holds the HMAC secret that signs pre-PR execution records) or the plan-sequence generation, lock and lock-claim files. This story adds the four entries to the canonical baseline so refresh heals existing installs, and adds a doctor warning when the secret is already tracked, without untracking it.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

The consumer `.gitignore` baseline written by install and refresh (`packages/core/src/init-deposit/gitignore.ts`) does not cover:

- `.deft/pre-pr-execution-private/`: the process-surviving private pre-PR store (`packages/core/src/pre-pr-controller/store.ts`, `PRE_PR_PRIVATE_STORE_DIR`). It holds the MAC secret that signs pre-PR execution records.
- `.deft/plan-sequence.json.generation`, `.deft/plan-sequence.json.lock` and `.deft/plan-sequence.json.lock.claim-*`.

The framework repo does not see this because its own `.gitignore` ignores `.deft/*` and lists the plan-sequence files (lines 177-179). Consumers get only the named baseline.

## Impact

- `deft check` fails on a consumer checkout until these files are moved aside, and an agent then leaves a stash it may not drop.
- A consumer can commit the MAC secret. Anyone with the repository could then forge pre-PR execution records, which the controller trusts as proof that pre-PR ran.

## Expected

- Add `.deft/pre-pr-execution-private/`, `.deft/plan-sequence.json.generation`, `.deft/plan-sequence.json.lock` and `.deft/plan-sequence.json.lock.claim-*` to the canonical baseline, so refresh heals existing installs.
- If the secret file is already tracked, doctor warns and names the remediation (untrack and rotate). Do not untrack it silently.

## Acceptance

- After `directive upgrade` on a consumer checkout, `git check-ignore` reports all four paths as ignored.
- A test in `packages/core/src/init-deposit/` asserts the baseline contains them.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer project maintainer, I want the Directive .gitignore baseline to cover the private pre-PR store and the plan-sequence lock files, so that the HMAC secret is never committed and deft check does not fail on local runtime files.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Add .deft/pre-pr-execution-private/, .deft/plan-sequence.json.generation, .deft/plan-sequence.json.lock and .deft/plan-sequence.json.lock.claim-* to CANONICAL_GITIGNORE_BASELINE (packages/core/src/init-deposit/gitignore.ts), so install and refresh write them.
2. Record the private store as a local-cache writer in runtime-writer-paths.json / runtime-writers.ts so the lockstep test covers it.
3. Add a doctor check (packages/core/src/doctor/checks.ts) that warns when .deft/pre-pr-execution-private/hmac-secret is tracked and names the remediation (git rm --cached, then rotate the secret). It never untracks.
4. Tests: baseline contents and refresh heal in gitignore.test.ts; doctor warn and no-index-change in checks.test.ts. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] line.

design-critique: not warranted, because it adds four lines to the consumer .gitignore baseline plus a doctor warning for an already-tracked secret; no new mechanism or authority.

Scott added this story to the through-merge pipeline ("Yes, add them", relayed by the dispatching session).

doctor warns when the pre-PR HMAC secret is tracked and names untrack and rotate
doctor never untracks the secret itself

The issue title is the one confession.
